in_marathi.name: Sagan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sagan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sahasrānāmam', the thousand names of Lord Vishnu, 'Sagan' refers to the god of the sky or space. In Hindu mythology, Sagan is believed to be the guardian of the universe and the giver of life.

vedic_reference.note: सगण (सगण्) is a Sanskrit word which means 'Victory in War'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word सग (सग्) which means 'together' or 'with'. The long meaning of the name is विजयी सेना (vijayī senā), which means 'victorious army'.
